RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Parma, Ohio, operates under a mayor-council form of government. The Mayor is Timothy J. DeGeeter. The City Council includes a President, Clerk of Council, and nine Ward Council members. The Clerk of Council is an elected official but typically serves an administrative role for the council rather than representing a ward as a voting member.
